text: 尾盘多只宽基ETF显著放量，沪深300ETF华泰柏瑞（510300）尾盘近半小时成交超30亿元，中证1000ETF南方（512100）、中证500ETF南方（510500）、中证1000ETF广发（560010）尾盘半小时均成交超10亿元。
text_en: Late in trading, several broad-based ETFs saw significant volume expansion, with Huatai-PineBridge CSI 300 ETF (510300) trading over 3 billion yuan in the final half hour, and China Southern CSI 1000 ETF (512100), China Southern CSI 500 ETF (510500), and GF CSI 1000 ETF (560010) each trading over 1 billion yuan in the final 30 minutes.
